items.proposed: no selection biomarker (MGMT not an eligibility row)
items.reason: Inclusion only requires records 'documenting ... (MGMT) promoter methylation status analysis or ... tumor tissue samples available ... for MGMT status determination'; no MGMT status is required, so MGMT is not an entry requirement on the tumour. Either way it is never candidate-matched (OKN-007 is not MGMT-targeting).
No tumour biomarker value is required for entry; the MGMT clause is a documentation/tissue-availability requirement and any MGMT status is acceptable.

note: Temozolomide rechallenge in every patient is coded soc_backbone by both coders (not queued); the question is OKN-007 ('OKN-007 Combined With Temozolomide').
